entry_item.definition: [Pers. dāroγā] n. Chief, superior; chairman; commander; director, manager; elder.

example.definition: Chiefs, commanders, the staff, administrative officers, executives.
To make or install as a chief, superior, etc.
Equerry, master of the horse, overseer of horses (in stables of princes).
Chief or mayor of a village.

entry_item.definition: chef, gouverneur, lieutenant, mandataire, commissaire, surveillant

example.definition: chef d'une tribu ou d'une province
